timing_contract: Alternating independent processes; round0 first-call excluded from medians, retained in raw rows. All accepted baseline output hashes enforced on every result. Unique removes byte-identical payload duplicates before API, so its speedup cannot be due to batch duplicate sharing. No input/filesystem cold-cache claim. Process peak working set includes loading, verification and retained results; not heap payload. Instrumented timing is diagnostic only and must not be used as performance evidence.
caveats: Discard pilot all/t1 comparison affected by overlapping inventory; ordinary repeat cohort used separately.
Ordinary cohort has mixed subgroup results, so wave1 is not accepted as a universal performance improvement.
Diagnostic phase wall times are not CPU or speedup measurements; unchanged phases also varied with CPU placement.
